events.name: FalsificationRequested
events.description: The loop entered the falsification gate. A consumer that computes the verdict listens for this, runs its check, and routes its result into SURVIVED or FAILED via a listens override.
events.synonyms: falsify, test the prediction, try to break it

events.name: VerificationRequested
events.description: The loop entered the independent-verification gate. A consumer routes its second-method result into CHECKS_AGREE or CHECKS_DISAGREE via a listens override.

events.name: CalibrationRequested
events.description: The loop entered the calibration gate and is waiting for a reliability score (CONFIRM_SCORE, data.score), which the atom checks against reliabilityThreshold.

events.name: LoopConcluded
events.description: A claim cleared calibration; a composing host can act on the validated result.
events.synonyms: validated, calibrated, concluded, ready to ship

events.name: CHANGE_CONDITION
events.description: The investigation's title and current hypothesis were entered.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Falsification is judged by a person
overridableConfigKeys.description: On: the falsification gate renders Survived / Failed buttons and a person decides. Off: no buttons render; the consumer's own sibling trait must answer FalsificationRequested by routing its result into SURVIVED / FAILED through a listens override.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: manual falsification, human judged, automated check off

overridableConfigKeys.label: Verification is judged by a person
overridableConfigKeys.description: On: the verification gate renders Checks-agree / Checks-disagree buttons. Off: the consumer's sibling trait answers VerificationRequested by routing its result into CHECKS_AGREE / CHECKS_DISAGREE through a listens override.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: manual verification, human second opinion, automated cross-check off

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reliability threshold
overridableConfigKeys.description: The measured reliability score a calibrated claim must clear before it is considered good enough to act on. Below it, the loop returns to falsification for more testing.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: confidence threshold, calibration bar, minimum reliability

overridableConfigKeys.label: Require independent verification
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether a second, independent check must agree before the claim advances. Off skips straight to generalization once falsification survives.
